name: iCard Checkout for WooCommerce
author: iCard

sections.description:
iCard Checkout for WooCommerce is a complete payment gateway solution that enables you to accept all major debit and credit cards, with regular settlement to your merchant account.

Key Features

  • Regular settlement: Get your money in seconds, not days.
  • No monthly fees: Pay only a small fee per transaction.
  • Fast checkout: Complete payments in under 20 seconds.
  • Easy integration: Simple setup with minimal configuration.
  • Multi-currency support: Accept payments in 7+ currencies (EUR, USD, GBP, etc.).
  • Secure transactions: PCI-DSS compliant with 3D Secure support.
  • Advanced fraud protection: Reduce chargebacks and disputes.
  • Seamless refunds: Process refunds directly from WooCommerce admin.

Available Countries

iCard Checkout is available in the following countries:

Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, the Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, and Sweden.

How It Works

  1. Customer selects iCard Checkout at your WooCommerce checkout.
  2. They’re redirected to iCard’s secure payment page.
  3. After completing payment, they return to your Thank you page.
  4. iCard sends a secure notification to confirm the transaction.
  5. Order status is automatically updated in your WooCommerce admin.

Security

  • Request signing with cryptographic signatures
  • Response verification for all notifications
  • HTTPS communication for all API requests
  • PCI-DSS compliant payment processing

Requirements

  • PHP 7.4 or higher.
  • WordPress 6.8+.
  • WooCommerce 9.9+.
  • HTTPS (SSL certificate) – Required for secure transactions.

Support

Need help? Contact our support team:

  • Email: cs.integration@icard.com
  • Website: iCard Official Website
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your WordPress site.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin interface.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  4. Enable and configure iCard Checkout.

Requirements

The minimum PHP version required for the iCard Checkout plugin is 7.4 or greater
In order to process card transactions successfully iCard Checkout requires secure connection by using HTTPS protocol.
You should install an SSL certificate onto your website to initiate a secure session. If your website is not using SSL certificate,
your transactions will be automatically reversed by the system.
sections.faq:
What payment acceptance methods can I accept?

With the iCard Checkout plugin, you can accept most EMV-based prepaid, debit and credit cards.

Where can I find settings needed for test environment?

Contact with cs.integration@icard.com to receive instructions and test configuration data.

How do I process refunds?

Refunds can be processed directly from the WooCommerce order page, just like with any other payment gateway.
